myth: Right to Recall will cause constant political instability.
fact: Well-designed recall uses high signature thresholds, verification, and time limits. It is a rare, serious tool, not an everyday disruption.
Recall deepens democracy by keeping representatives accountable to voters between elections, always within constitutional limits.

myth: Recall does not exist anywhere in India.
fact: Recall provisions already exist in several state municipal and panchayat laws for certain local representatives.

myth: Any citizen can remove a leader at any time.
fact: Recall requires meeting strict legal thresholds and a defined process. It is deliberate and rule-bound, not arbitrary.
Recall complements elections. It is an accountability mechanism, not a substitute for the electoral process.
